product_metadata.title: iDesign Vine Soap Saver, Bar Holder Tray for Bathroom Counter, Shower, Kitchen, 5.5" x 3.45" x 2", Vanilla and Bronze
features: BAR SOAP HOLDER: Soap saver holds bar soap, sponges, scrubbies, dish brushes, razors, small accessories, and more. Great for use in master bathroom, guest bathroom, kid's bathroom, kitchen, shower, laundry room, or mudroom
DURABLE: Made of rust-resistant, durable steel and ceramic insert for years of quality use
STYLISH: White ceramic with a bronze leaf-design is a fashionable combination and perfect for any decor
RAISED EDGES: Ridged design of ceramic insert allows soap to dry quickly
IDEAL SIZE: Soap saver measures 5.5" x 3.45" x 2", perfect for your counter
description: The iDesign Vine Soap Saver is your solution to keeping soap bars clean and dry. This oval bar soap holder is great for keeping soap or sponges within arm's reach at any sink. The trays are made of durable bronze steel with a vanilla ceramic insert to provide years of quality use. The leaf-design surrounding the ceramic is elegant and matches any style. The ceramic insert features raised ridges to hold and dry your soap or sponge to prevent any slipping off the base or around the counter. The insert is removable to make cleaning easy! These soap holders are great to use in the bathroom, shower, kitchen, or laundry room. The iDesign Vine Soap Saver measures 5.5" x 3.45" x 2", perfect for your counter space. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
